South Australia fire map

Track active South Australia bushfires on a live SA fire map. See fires in South Australia today (location, size and status) with official warnings from SA Country Fire Service and MFS, fire danger ratings by district and satellite hotspots.

Incidents and warnings on this page come from SA Country Fire Service and MFS. Fire danger ratings come from the Australian Fire Danger Rating System, and satellite hotspots from Geoscience Australia's DEA Hotspots. Your browser fetches each feed directly and refreshes it every few minutes.

Official information: SA CFS incidents and warnings.

This site uses PostHog for anonymous usage analytics (pages viewed, features used, errors and load times). It sets a first-party cookie to count return visits, and does not collect names, emails or accounts.

Data sources

Every figure on this page is fetched live by your browser from the agencies below. There is no server in between. Feeds refresh every 1–5 minutes. Australia has no single national fire feed, so each state is read separately. Containment percentages and crew numbers aren't published here, so the page shows each agency's own status, size and resources instead.
